metadata.title: Hand Hygiene on the Ward
metadata.description: The five moments for hand hygiene, the right technique and how long disinfection takes to work.

resource.content: Before patient contact, before aseptic tasks, after contact with body fluids, after patient contact and after touching the patient's surroundings.
Use enough disinfectant to keep both hands wet for the full 30 seconds. Fingertips and thumbs are the areas most often missed.
